Character Counts Program

Developing Great Hearts
and Strong Minds

Through our Character Counts program, we nurture six pillars of character that define our students' journey. Our clubs take turns to campaign for good character through active monthly exercises.

favorite Caring balance Fairness verified_user Trust task_alt Responsibility handshake Respect public Citizenship
favorite Campaign Color: Red

The Caring
Club

"Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see." Our Caring Club focuses on empathy, compassion, and the joy of helping others.

balance Campaign Color: Orange

The Fairness
Club

Playing by the rules, taking turns, and being open-minded. The Fairness Club promotes equity and justice in all school activities.

verified_user Campaign Color: Blue

The Trustworthiness
Club

Honesty, integrity, and loyalty. Our Trustworthiness Club teaches students the value of being reliable and standing up for what is right.

task_alt Campaign Color: Green

The Responsibility
Club

Doing what you are supposed to do, persistent excellence, and self-discipline. The Responsibility Club encourages students to take ownership of their actions.

handshake Campaign Color: Yellow

The Respect
Club

Treating others with kindness, being tolerant of differences, and using good manners. The Respect Club is the heartbeat of our inclusive community.

public Campaign Color: Purple

The Citizenship
Club

Making your school and community better, cooperating, and being a good neighbor. The Citizenship Club inspires students to be active and positive global citizens.

Experience Character in Action

Join us during our monthly character campaigns to see how our students embody these vital traits.
